title: A Trip to the Aquarium
passage:
On Friday morning, Mr. Chen's class went to the city aquarium for a field trip. Mia and her best friend Leo were very excited because they love sea animals.

When they arrived, they walked straight to the shark tank. "Wow, that shark is bigger than my dad's car!" Leo said. Mia laughed and said, "I think the dolphins are more interesting than the sharks. Let's go see the dolphin show next."

The dolphins jumped high and splashed water on the front rows. Everyone got a little wet, but nobody was angry. It was too much fun to be upset.

After the show, the class visited the gift shop. Mia wanted to buy a stuffed penguin, but it was too expensive for her to buy. She chose a small shark keychain instead. Leo bought a postcard with a picture of a jellyfish on it.

By three o'clock, everyone was tired from all the walking. "I'm too tired to walk anymore," said Mia. Their teacher smiled and said, "Don't worry. The bus is waiting outside. You should rest on the bus."

On the way back to school, Leo looked out the window and said, "This was the best field trip of the year!" Mia nodded. "I agree. The aquarium was more amazing than I expected. I can't wait to tell my parents about the sharks and dolphins!"

That night, Mia wrote in her diary, "Today I learned that sea animals are smarter than I thought. I hope our class can visit the aquarium again next year."

grammar: 比較級 (Comparative Adjectives)：單音節形容詞加 -er + than（big → bigger than）；多音節形容詞用 more + 形容詞 + than（interesting → more interesting than）。例：The shark is bigger than my dad's car. / The aquarium was more amazing than I expected.
too + 形容詞 + (for + 人) + to V：表示「太...以至於不能...」。若句中有動作的對象，須加 for + 人。例：I'm too tired to walk anymore. / The penguin was too expensive for her to buy.
should 表建議：should + 原形動詞,表示「應該」，語氣較 must 委婉。例：You should rest on the bus.

reading.q: Why were Mia and Leo excited about the field trip?
reading.ex: 文中提到 "Mia and her best friend Leo were very excited because they love sea animals."，故選 B。

reading.q: What did Leo say about the shark?
opts: It was smaller than a car
It was bigger than his dad's car
reading.ex: Leo 說 "that shark is bigger than my dad's car!"，故選 B。

reading.q: Why did Mia choose the shark keychain instead of the stuffed penguin?
opts: The penguin was too expensive for her
The gift shop had no penguins
reading.ex: 文中提到企鵝玩偶 "too expensive for her to buy"，所以她選了鑰匙圈，故選 B。

reading.q: What did the teacher tell the students to do on the bus?
reading.ex: 老師說 "You should rest on the bus."，故選 C。

reading.q: How did Mia feel about the trip, according to her diary?
opts: She learned sea animals are smarter than she thought
She never wants to go again
She was scared of the dolphins
reading.ex: 日記寫著 "sea animals are smarter than I thought"，故選 B。

grammar.q: That shark is ___ than my dad's car.
grammar.ex: 單音節形容詞 big 的比較級為 bigger，後接 than，故選 B。

grammar.q: I think the dolphins are ___ than the sharks.
grammar.ex: 多音節形容詞 interesting 的比較級須用 more + 形容詞 + than，故選 B。

grammar.q: The stuffed penguin was too expensive ___ Mia to buy.
grammar.ex: too + 形容詞 + for + 人 + to V，表示「對某人來說太...而不能」，故選 A。
too + 形容詞 + to + 動詞，表示「太...而不能」，故選 A。

grammar.q: Their teacher said, "You ___ rest on the bus."
grammar.ex: should 為助動詞,後面須接動詞原形,故選 A。

vocab.q: Which word means "a place where people can see fish and sea animals"?
vocab.ex: aquarium 意為「水族館」，故選 A。

vocab.q: "The dolphins jumped high and ___ water on the front rows."
vocab.ex: 句子為過去式敘述，dolphins 為複數主詞但動詞用過去式 splashed，故選 B。

vocab.q: Which word best describes something that costs a lot of money?
vocab.ex: expensive 意為「昂貴的」，故選 B。

vocab.q: A small sea animal with a soft, round body and no bones is called a ___.
vocab.ex: jellyfish 意為「水母」，符合題目描述，故選 C。

vocab.q: A school trip to a place outside the classroom, like a museum or aquarium, is called a ___.
vocab.ex: field trip 意為「校外教學」，故選 A。
